UserData.title: UserData
UserData.description: User financial tracker state containing accounts, transactions, savings pools, categories, and settings

userId.description: Unique Firebase Authentication UID of the owner

accounts.description: List of bank card, e-wallet, and cash accounts with current balances

transactions.description: Ledger history of all income, expense, and transfer records

savingsPools.description: Dedicated savings goals and pools with pacing targets

categories.description: Customized income, expense, and transfer categories

settings.description: Application settings including exchange rates, currency views, and theme

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the most recent sync

updatedBy.description: Device identifier that initiated the update

/users/{userId}/data/{docId}.description: User specific data documents under users/{userId}/data collection path
